reason: Provides an image_gen tool that uses the Codex CLI to generate images, saves them in the session workspace, and optionally renders them inline in the Web UI.

summaries.zh: 通过 Codex CLI 为智能体提供 image_gen 图片生成工具，并将生成的图片保存到会话工作区及可选地在 Web UI 中预览。
summaries.en: Provides agents with an image_gen tool backed by the Codex CLI, saving generated images to the session workspace and optionally previewing them in the Web UI.

capabilities: Invokes the Codex CLI through a subprocess to generate images
Writes generated image files into the session workspace
Runs image generation as a background job and exposes job results
Provides a web UI preview through a plugin connection RPC
